**RE: Appeal of adverse benefit determination — total knee replacement (CPT 27447)**

- **Member:** Morgan Brooks
- **Member ID:** W188108937
- **Reference number:** POC-5585B8DEE7-94152
- **Date of denial notice:** 2026-08-12
- **Plan:** Oscar Health (Commercial/ACA), State of Texas
- **Governing policy:** Oscar Clinical Guideline: Total Knee Arthroplasty (Replacement) (CG069, Ver. 7) — https://assets.ctfassets.net/plyq12u1bv8a/6gD2u32BuCEgffIXeNXN8s/e0cf91116d52b7fd2a32e90e78a6d89d/CG069_Total_Knee_Arthroplasty.pdf

---

## What I am asking for

I am appealing the denial of my total knee replacement (CPT 27447), issued on 2026-08-12 under reference number POC-5585B8DEE7-94152. I am asking Oscar Health to reconsider that decision and to approve the surgery my surgeon, Okafor, MD, has documented as needed.

The notice states that the documentation submitted was incomplete and did not allow a determination of medical necessity. I am writing because the information the plan's own guideline asks for was gathered and documented before the request was made. Below, I set out each criterion from the guideline in the plan's own words and point to the record that corresponds to it, so the reviewer can match them line by line.

---

## The plan's criteria and the records

The guideline opens the medical necessity section this way:

> "The member meets medical necessity for advanced joint disease as indicated by ALL of the following:"

### 1. Imaging evidence of advanced joint destruction

The guideline requires:

> "Radiologic or arthroscopic ﬁndings of advanced knee joint destruction documented by the treating surgeon and/or radiologist for ONE of the following:"

and the first of the listed options is:

> "Kellgren Lawrence Grade IV radiographic ﬁndings (Table 1); or"

**The records establish this.** Weight-bearing knee radiographs dated 2026-07-01 show bone-on-bone apposition in the medial and patellofemoral compartments with lateral joint-space narrowing, read as Kellgren-Lawrence grade 4. My physical exam also documents varus alignment, crepitus and effusion, with range of motion of 5 to 100 degrees. The guideline's list includes further alternatives — exposed subchondral bone, symptomatic angular deformity with accompanying radiographic changes, and symptomatic avascular necrosis — but only one of the listed findings is required, and the grade 4 radiographic finding is documented in my chart by imaging.

### 2. Severe pain for at least three months

The guideline requires:

> "Severe pain persisting in the affected knee that interferes with functional activity or age-appropriate activities for at least 3 months (e.g., ambulation, prolonged standing, ability to sleep); and"

**The records establish this.** My chart documents nine months of progressive knee pain that is not relieved by rest. I cannot climb stairs without assistance, and I wake three to four times a night because of the pain. Nine months exceeds the three months the guideline states, and the specific examples the guideline gives — ambulation and ability to sleep — are the exact functions my records show are affected.

### 3. Failure of a three-month trial of conservative treatment

The guideline requires:

> "There has been a failure to decrease pain or improve function after at least a 3-month trial of conservative treatment (non-surgical) which has included ALL of the following:"

The components named in the excerpts I have are:

> "Active and ongoing participation in physical therapy (documented) or a well-documented home exercise program under the supervision of a physical therapist or physician (e.g., lower extremity ﬂexibility and strengthening program, activity modiﬁcation, and/or weight loss program), unless poorly tolerated or contraindicated; and"

> "Oral/topical medications (e.g., analgesics, NSAIDs, serotonin/norepinephrine reuptake Inhibitor (duloxetine)), unless poorly tolerated or contraindicated; and"

**The records establish both components, and the failure.**

- *Physical therapy:* supervised physical therapy focused on quadriceps strengthening and range of motion, from 2026-05-07 through 2026-07-16 — 10 weeks and 18 completed visits — documented in the physical therapy discharge note. This is supervised, documented, active and ongoing participation of the kind the guideline describes, including a lower-extremity strengthening program.
- *Medication:* NSAIDs for four months, with inadequate relief.
- *Failure:* after that care, my pain and function have not improved. I still cannot climb stairs without assistance and still wake three to four times nightly.

My conservative care spans well beyond three months overall — nine months of symptoms, four months of NSAID treatment, and a documented 10-week course of supervised therapy. The excerpts of the guideline I have do not state a separate minimum number of weeks or visits for the physical therapy component itself, so if Oscar applied a specific threshold to that component, I ask that the plan identify it in its response.

### 4. No steroid injection within three months of surgery

The guideline requires:

> "No intra-articular steroid injections to the knee within three months before the surgery date; and"

**This criterion can be satisfied as scheduled.** My records document one corticosteroid injection, on 2026-06-08, which gave only about three weeks of partial relief. Because that date is now well in the past, any surgical date on or after 2026-09-08 falls outside the three-month window the guideline describes. My surgery has not yet taken place, and the date can be set accordingly: [surgery date, to be scheduled on approval].

### 5. No contraindication present

The guideline requires:

> "No contraindication present or the request is not considered Experimental or Investigational, or Not Medically Necessary, as listed in this guideline; or"

**The records establish this.** My chart documents no active infection, no untreated substance use, and a BMI of 29. The guideline's list of contraindications and exclusions is referenced but was not reproduced in the material I have; if Oscar believes a listed contraindication applies to me, I ask that it be identified specifically.

### 6. Nicotine use recommendation

The guideline states:

> "If the member is a smoker or nicotine product user, it is recommended the member has stopped using within 4 weeks of surgery or has been provided a well-documented education plan on options to quit such as referral to a cessation program, pharmacologic, and over-the-counter treatments."

**This does not apply to me.** My records document that I am a non-smoker.

### Criteria that do not apply to my case

The guideline also lists alternative qualifying pathways, including:

> "Failure of previous surgical interventions such as ONE of the following: a. Previous proximal tibial or distal femoral osteotomy; or b. Previous unicompartmental knee replacement with continued pain interfering with ADLs; or"

> "Post-traumatic injury (e.g., fracture, infection) causing debilitating knee joint destruction affecting movement, causing pain and stiffness; or"

> "Bone tumor involving the knee that requires resection and total reconstruction."

These are alternative routes to coverage and are not the basis of my request. I qualify under the advanced joint disease pathway set out above. The guideline also contains a criterion regarding a separately requested device — "If there is a separate request for the device, implant or prosthesis that will be inserted during surgery, it must be FDA approved (unless the member is enrolled in an approved clinical trial as deﬁned by the plan beneﬁt); and" — and if a separate device request is required in my case, my surgeon can supply that information on request.

---

## A note on the reason given

The denial was based on incomplete documentation rather than on a finding that any specific criterion was not met. The records described above — imaging dated 2026-07-01, the physical therapy discharge note covering 2026-05-07 to 2026-07-16, the medication history, the injection date, and the exam findings — address each criterion in the guideline that I have been given. If any particular document is still considered missing, I ask that Oscar tell me in writing exactly which criterion it relates to and which record it needs, so my surgeon's office and I can supply it without further delay.

Several of the excerpts I was able to review introduce lists of further conditions that were not reproduced in the material available to me. For that reason, I also ask that the plan identify in its response the specific criteria from the Oscar Clinical Guideline: Total Knee Arthroplasty (Replacement) (CG069, Ver. 7) that it applied in reaching this determination.

---

## Closing request

I respectfully ask Oscar Health to overturn the denial of reference number POC-5585B8DEE7-94152 and authorize total knee replacement (CPT 27447) as requested by Okafor, MD. If the appeal cannot be resolved in my favor on the current record, I ask for a written explanation identifying the specific guideline criterion at issue and the documentation required, and I ask to be advised of any further levels of review available to me.

I understand that my appeal must be received by Oscar Health no later than **2027-02-08**, which is 180 days from the date of the denial notice. I am submitting this letter, together with the completed Grievance and Appeal form for my state and my supporting documentation, by [mail / fax / email — select one], using the appeal address printed on my denial letter. The contact details I am using are: email help@hioscar.com, Attn: Grievances; fax 888-977-2062; phone 855-672-2755. If a different form or address should be used for my appeal, please let me know and I will resubmit promptly.

Documents enclosed:
- Weight-bearing knee radiograph report dated 2026-07-01
- Physical therapy discharge note (2026-05-07 to 2026-07-16, 18 visits)
- Office/clinical notes from Okafor, MD, including exam findings and medication history
- Copy of the denial notice dated 2026-08-12
- [Any additional records requested by Oscar]

Thank you for reviewing this appeal.

Sincerely,

**Morgan Brooks**

Phone: [phone number]
